other.comment: XRT: The source is below the RASS limit but does not show definitive signs of fading. This is most likely the afterglow, given also the reported redshift of z=2.14 (Saccardi et al. GCN Circ. 33281) but further observations are required to assess for fading.; UVOT: no detection
